summary: The customer called to dispute a forty-dollar activation fee that should have been waived under an online upgrade promotion. The agent verified the account, identified a system error that failed to apply the waiver, issued an immediate forty-dollar credit to resolve the issue, and successfully closed the call.

evidence.text: I am going to issue a credit of forty dollars to your account right now.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Issue a 40 dollar credit to the customer's account immediately.

evidence.text: I completely understand your frustration with unexpected charges.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent immediately acknowledged the customer's frustration with empathy and validated their concern.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Metro Telecom customer service, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, professional, and courteous demeanor throughout the entire interaction.

evidence.text: I am going to issue a credit of forty dollars to your account right now. It will reflect on your balance immediately and cover this billing cycle.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully diagnosed the problem and resolved it completely by issuing an immediate credit.

evidence.text: May I have your phone number and account PIN, please?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent correctly followed verification procedures by asking for the phone number and account PIN.

evidence.text: It looks like the system failed to automatically apply the waiver at checkout. That was definitely an error on our end.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately identified the root cause of the billing discrepancy by checking the promotion code and system notes.

evidence.text: Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent spoke clearly, asked precise questions, and explained the resolution in an easy-to-understand manner.

evidence.text: Thank you for choosing Metro Telecom and have a wonderful rest of your day!
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly checked for additional needs, thanked the customer, and provided a professional closing.
